body:
PR-06 adds separate truthful JS wall instrumentation for capture/comparison/queue/job/SDK/postprocess/cleanup/engine/Canvas work and matching first-draw latency, with a compact ordinary HUD and collapsible details. **This checkpoint corrects independent PR06-F01; independent closure is pending re-review by the same reviewer.** Keep Draft. No merge, auto-merge, deploy or later roadmap work.

[Independent PR15 finding](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/pull/15) was scoped FAIL at `04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9`. Replacing only stages with null in a genuine snapshot reproduced the exact React failure/video unmount. **The fault is injected; no naturally occurring collector route to that malformed shape or ordinary production incidence has been established.** That qualification and PR15 evidence are preserved.

The correction validates a bounded owned display projection **at HUD publication, before React state**. Malformed stages/rows/counts/flags/times/counters become unavailable instead of unmounting the product. Valid real 0 ms, null/no-execution/overflow, missing durations, truncated windows and latest-300 coverage remain intact. Each counter is read once; raw objects/getters are not retained in React. This also recovers if a faulty producer mutates and reuses its snapshot reference. Existing details memoization/disclosure and camera/model/scheduler ownership remain. No broad App error handling or product failure path was added.

[Correction report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e/docs/verification/pr06-f01-correction/REPORT.md) · [finding response](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e/docs/verification/pr06-f01-correction/finding-response.json) · [commands/exits](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e/docs/verification/pr06-f01-correction/commands.jsonl) · [source/reviewer bindings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e/docs/verification/pr06-f01-correction/source-binding.json) · [HUD cost](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e/docs/verification/pr06-f01-correction/hud-cost-report.md) · [original measurement contract](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/measurement-contract.md).

**Before/after:** unchanged reviewer UI reproducer before exits1 (1 pass / 1 fail), videoMounted=false and pendingRAF=0. Corrected author replay passes **all31 original reviewer probes**, unchanged. This is author replay, not independent PASS. **67 new regressions** cover null/missing stages, malformed nested values/coverage/counts, nonfinite/coercible values, throwing/changing getters, same-reference recovery, copied ownership and valid partial/zero rendering. Actual App tests keep the same video node, RAF acquisition/draw, active SDK work, one camera/model creation, ready request ID, result cleanup and ordinary unmount release.

Final product validation: locked install, typecheck, lint, build, normal-production double isolation and whitespace checks; **317 unit tests /188 focused /19 serial real React/CSS browser cases /7 controls** (2 intact, 5 expected fault detections), all pass. Browser artifacts/screenshots are new copies from a disposable corrected checkout; all91 historical author evidence hashes still match. No old assertion was removed/weakened; no retry/sleep/timeout increase or broad stabilization.

The collector/probe, scheduler, engine, Canvas renderer, existing FPS estimator, camera hook, coordinates, dictionary, speech, SDK factory/version, package/lock and workflow are **byte-identical to the reviewed head**. Capture/SDK timestamps, generation/image identity, resource ownership, outcome/window/quantile arithmetic and all six measurement requirements remain. No Worker/hash/thinning/mask/coordinate/optimization redesign.

**Cost validation:** the changed publication+React path has **144 matched trials /4608 snapshot+render operations**, six fresh/300/truncated × closed/open profiles, balanced alternating pairs and excluded warmup. Healthy HTML matches. Paired preparation mean-delta medians range −0.00156 to +0.01406 ms/publication; raw tails/variance/unfavorable observations remain. Only the fixed40-row reader is added at250ms; nothing is added per capture/SDK/draw. Earlier author288/reviewer96 pipeline trials remain historical evidence at their original heads, with unchanged-path source bindings; their old HUD/end-to-end numbers are not relabelled corrected-head measurements. The targeted new HUD experiment measures the affected path, without an arbitrary1ms or device guarantee.

Setup evidence remains honest: the first HUD comparison failed because native open state carried between different arms; a controlled check proves that was the sole HTML difference. The corrected harness equalizes disclosure and checkpoints all trials. Initial failed-run early timings were not checkpointed and are not used. Four raw Vitest logs retain exact bytes in gzip; readable copies only remove terminal blank lines so whitespace checks remain intact.

Local cloud Node24.19.0/npm11.9.0/system Chromium154.0.8037.57. Previous local matched-browser download restriction respected without retry/bypass. Real physical camera/model/GPU/audio/mobile/background and deployed-public equality remain unverified. Prior PR04 RGBA/coalescing and PR05 T01 timing conditions remain. Main/PR15 head/tree unchanged; same author branch, fast-forward publication only.

**Exact corrected-head hosted CI: completed/success.** [Run40110781409 / job120921859541](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40110781409/job/120921859541) passes locked install, typecheck/lint/build, **317 unit /19 browser /7 controls**. Downloaded raw logs explicitly verify ref/fetch/checkout/git-log HEAD `7056c67cd1f59c8d3e2237b84df05c223d99a25e`. Hosted Node24.19.0/npm11.17.0, matched Chrome for Testing156.0.8078.4/Playwrightv1248, distinct from local system Chromium154. Artifact12566069269 binds the same head, digest `sha256:6a48861be08ba92597b4ec6fb3056d9d8089c024ab72cf4510080e616eaba297`. Public branch/FETCH_HEAD/tree match the frozen binding; worktree is clean. Old-head CI does not close F01 or substitute for this run. Independent closure is still pending.

Return this frozen checkpoint to the same independent reviewer after CI verification. PR06-F01 is author-addressed, pending independent closure; no self-declared independent PASS.
